## Agreement

These Terms of Use apply to Void Business, published by an independent developer trading as AndySocial ("we", "us"). Your use of the app is also governed by Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (the "Standard EULA"): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/. ## The game

Void Business is a single-player simulation game for entertainment. All companies, coins, products, people and news in the game are fictional. Nothing in the game is financial advice.

## Virtual items

In-game cash, businesses, upgrades, card skins and other items are virtual. They have no real-world monetary value, cannot be exchanged for money or real goods, and are licensed to you, not sold. We may adjust game balance at any time.

## Purchases

In-app purchases and the VIP subscription are billed by Apple to your Apple Account. Prices are shown in the app and confirmed by Apple before you pay. Refunds are handled by Apple under Apple's policies and your statutory rights. Use Restore Purchases in the shop to restore non-consumable purchases and an active subscription on a new device.

## VIP subscription

VIP is an auto-renewable subscription, available as VIP Monthly (1 month) and VIP Yearly (1 year). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the price shown for the same period unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings (iOS Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions). Cancelling stops future charges; VIP benefits continue until the end of the period you have paid for.

If the price changes, Apple notifies you under its standard rules and you can cancel before the new price applies.

## Digital content and cancellations

Under UK consumer law, when you buy digital content for immediate delivery you agree that supply begins immediately and you lose the 14-day cancellation right once delivery begins. Your statutory rights for faulty content are not affected.
